evals.prompt: Evaluate a classification model's predictions on evals/files/predictions.csv. Compute accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and AUC-ROC. Generate a confusion matrix.
evals.expected_output: Evaluation report with accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC-ROC scores. Confusion matrix table. Identified class imbalance if present.

evals.prompt: Evaluate regression predictions in evals/files/regression_predictions.csv. Compute RMSE, MAE, R², and residual distribution.
evals.expected_output: Regression evaluation with RMSE, MAE, R², residual plot saved to figures/. Identified any systematic bias in predictions.
